Content: Seven-seat adversarial whole-codebase audit on audit/skeleton-animation-improvements-2026-09-07. Seats: runtime correctness; editor/runtime boundary; skeleton/IK; ownership/aliasing; performance/Burst; Unity lifecycle/diagnostics; task/document integrity. Concrete fixes landed: runtime geometry attachment resolution now uses SemanticBoneResolver.ResolveGeometryAttachmentBoneId; editor/runtime material regions now honor each MaterialRegion.SubmeshIndex; runtime accessory iteration no longer assumes implicit geometry is index 0; ResolvedPolyline rejects non-finite positions/segment lengths and total-length overflow; GenerationSettings.EstimateSampleCount uses saturating axis increments; MeshExtractionResult rejects duplicate indices within a triangle; CreatureMeshGenerator disposes part SDF programs when body compilation fails and transactionally destroys untransferred Unity meshes on assembly failure; CurveAdapter rejects non-finite legacy verticalOffset; RigSkinningSweepDiagnostic uses invariant numeric formatting and complete JSON control-character escaping; runtime preview no longer double-clones a freshly loaded definition before scheduler capture. New tasks: TSK-0182, TSK-0183, TSK-0184, TSK-0185, TSK-0186, all source-level Done. Existing ownership retained: TSK-0104 owns bounded scheduler/coalescing/cancellation and generated Unity preview ownership; TSK-0095 owns resolved-stage authority and immutable generation handoff; TSK-0160 owns malformed extraction topology; TSK-0137 owns legacy migration policy; TSK-0169 owns live skinning diagnostic execution. Historical findings were explicitly rejected when stale (indexed pose resolution, documented non-uniform SDF approximation) or duplicate (winding direction, output ownership, parser grammar). Self-review caught and corrected several implementation hazards: allocation-producing HashSet duplicate-influence guard replaced with bounded comparisons; compact Marching Cubes edge key corrected for rectangular dimensions; reconstructed files were compared/restored to preserve existing documentation and tests. Branch integrity was checked at commit 21ca1b286e89bb236046c49ce96fd486d78ca7 before the audit report; subsequent writes advanced the branch. No automated tests or Unity execution were performed during this campaign, so runtime/editor/deformation validation remains a separate evidence tier.
